title: "Supervisor review cover note"
last-reviewed: "2026-08-28"
---

## Blank template

**Material and version:** [ ]
**Current state:** exploratory / partial / full / near-final
**Purpose and intended reader:** [ ]
**Decision or claim this supports:** [ ]
**What I checked:** [evidence, alternatives, local requirements]
**My provisional view:** [recommendation and main limitation]
**Feedback requested now:** [one to three precise questions]
**Not useful to review yet:** [ ]
**Decision date and agreed review window:** [ ]
**Linked files and response record:** [ ]

## Completed example

**Material:** Recruitment flow v2.
**State:** discussion draft.
**Decision:** whether it is ready for privacy consultation.
**Checked:** partner contact route, inclusion criteria and current ethics guidance.
**Provisional view:** consult privacy adviser before drafting final recruitment text.
**Feedback requested:** Does the flow expose the consequential privacy questions and show what is still missing before consultation?
**Not yet:** sentence-level editing.
**Decision date:** 18 September.

## Scenario test

A supervisor has 20 minutes. The cover note lets them focus on the blocking decision rather than line-editing an exploratory document.
